en: An intent is a typed record above the milestones that realise it: a statement, its invariants, and satisfaction criteria each naming the evidence that settles it. Its stage is derived from the plan's milestone status and its satisfaction from the evidence ledger, never stored. A gate refuses an intent that names no milestone or evidence that resolves to nothing, a session's preflight names the intent its work serves or refuses, the Cockpit shows intents with measured and enforced coverage of its scripts, and a milestone closes on GitHub only when the intents it serves are satisfied.

Jeho fáze se odvozuje ze stavu milníků plánu a jeho splnění z ledgeru důkazů, nikdy se neukládá. Kontrola odmítne záměr, který nejmenuje žádný milník nebo má důkaz, který se nikam neřeší, preflight relace jmenuje záměr, kterému její práce slouží, nebo odmítne, Cockpit ukazuje záměry s měřeným a vynucovaným pokrytím jeho skriptů a milník se na GitHubu uzavře jen tehdy, jsou-li záměry, kterým slouží, splněny.

en: A subject's verdict is the one aggregation the claims and the rules already use, over its parts: a failing part makes the subject failing; otherwise the verdict is the weakest of the parts that can carry proof; otherwise the weakest of all its parts; and a subject with no part reads <t1/>. The totals of its parts, by state, are always beside the verdict, so one <t2/> part is never hidden behind it. A subject is judged over its own routes and its members' own verdicts, never over its members' raw routes. It is judged at the presented revision, as <t3/> judges a claim: a claim route is the claim join's proof, a command's routes go through the same truth table and the same monotone rule over the working ledger's uncommitted run, and the rules report, which judges the working tree, is capped by the presented tree, so a rule-derived <t4/> becomes <t5/> when the presented tree is not its commit, as every other route does. A surface that reads records beyond the tracked ledger may weaken a route before anything is aggregated, and never strengthen it: the route keeps the weaker of the two states.

Součty jeho částí podle stavu jsou vždy vedle verdiktu, takže jedna část <t2/> není za ním nikdy skryta.
